options.name: The Wind Remembers
options.story_approach: A coastal fort retains fragments of a distant relationship through environmental memory.
options.rendering_route: Living scene with restrained atmospheric/internal motion.

options.name: Letters Across the Water
options.story_approach: Two separated people remain connected through letters carried symbolically across water.
options.rendering_route: Painterly cinematic coverage and match cuts.

options.name: Island Memory Tapestry
options.story_approach: Maps, textile memory, sea travel, place and ancestry transform into one living artwork and distill into a single thread.
options.rendering_route: Hybrid painterly living-scene construction with selective cinematic transformations and bounded camera travel.

options.name: Island Dream / Ancestral Memory — Two Heroes
options.story_approach: A recurring male and female lead move through inherited island memory, separation and ancestral convergence until the world resolves into a living tapestry and inheritance thread.
options.rendering_route: Hybrid cinematic living-painting with stable hero continuity, readable island environments, structural memory morphs, layered ancestry and stronger approved FX usage.

user_selection.recorded_user_instruction: Route 4 selected. Add two recurring hero characters, one male and one female. Follow the repo and create media in batches only as needed.

large_batch_strategy.current_batch_goal: Establish immutable visual continuity for the recurring male and female heroes before any new environment/story plates are generated.
large_batch_strategy.next_batch_rule: Do not create the next media batch until the current batch is generated, QC-reviewed, hashed/registered and its downstream dependency is known.
large_batch_strategy.proof_policy: After storyboard/shot media exists, render short representative moving proofs before any full-song assembly.
